budget_items.topic: FY24 capital plan requests and free cash
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager cut FY24 Capital Plan requests from 29 items to 6, and the $2,860,000 in free cash that would normally fund capital requests will be reserved for abatements.
budget_items.quote: the $2,860,000 in free cash, which would normally fund capital plan requests, will be reserved to fund abatements.

budget_items.topic: Ambulance and dump trucks in the capital plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The capital plan would use $986,000 from the Special Purpose Stabilization Fund to buy a fire ambulance and a pair of DPW dump trucks.
budget_items.quote: the capital plan will use $986,000 out of the special purpose stabilization fund to purchase the very much needed ambulance for the fire department

budget_items.what_was_recorded: School security upgrades in the capital plan will be funded by unexpended capital and tax revenue; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: security upgrades for the schools, which will be funded by unexpended capital and tax revenue.

budget_items.topic: Waterfront property tax bills and overlay
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Waterfront owners received much higher real estate tax bills; the overlay account will probably need to be increased at Town Meeting to cover abatements. No dollar amounts were printed.
budget_items.quote: will probably need to be increased at town meeting in order to cover abatements.

budget_items.topic: State aid and circuit breaker funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: At the MMA trade show the Governor said she aims to fully fund the circuit breaker and look at Chapter 70 treatment of small towns; no dollar amounts were printed.
budget_items.quote: governor healy aims to fully fund the circuit breaker, and take a closer look at how small towns are treated regarding chapter 70 funds.
